title: Type-7 Transporter (Elite Dangerous)
intro: The Type-7 Transporter by Lakon is a large freighter with a single-seat cockpit at its front. It needs a large landing pad and uses the shared HOTAS layout.

panels.name: Type-7 Transporter: seats and hardpoints
panels.text: Facts about the Type-7 Transporter that set it apart from the other ships: its seats, its weapon mounts and the landing pad size it needs.
panels.context: Everything else in the Type-7 Transporter's cockpit works like in every other Elite Dangerous ship.

controls.name: Pilot seat (helm)
controls.text: The only seat of the Type-7 Transporter. The pilot sits here and flies the ship with the whole HOTAS layout of this guide.
controls.context: With one seat the Type-7 Transporter cannot take multicrew guests; the pilot does everything alone.

controls.name: Hardpoints (weapon mounts)
controls.text: The weapon mounts of the Type-7 Transporter: four small hardpoints. Bigger mounts take bigger, stronger weapons.
controls.context: The pilot puts the Type-7 Transporter's weapons into fire groups on the right panel and fires them with the trigger and the weapon release button.

controls.name: Landing pad size
controls.text: The Type-7 Transporter needs a large landing pad or a bigger one. Stations have small, medium and large pads, and small outposts may not have the bigger ones.
controls.context: When the pilot asks a station for docking, the station gives a pad that fits the ship's size.
